purpose: Name the directly selected type-0x7C template used by the Level 05 timed/cadence spawn path.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_7C_LEVEL05_TIMED_SPAWN
templates.post_initialize: The Level 05 callback computes a level-relative position for the timed spawn and sets the actor facing conditionally from the resulting horizontal coordinate.

conclusion: The Level 05 callback directly selects the exact 20-byte type-0x7C record at 0x001B819C. Adjacent type-0x7C records at 0x001B81B0 and 0x001B81C4 have no direct static references and remain unresolved.
